Our partner is looking for an Influencer & Media Manager based in Sweden. We are looking for an experienced Influencer & Media Manager to strengthen the reputation and visibility of a growing independent PC and console games publishing label. In this role, you will lead PR initiatives, develop media relationships and build strategic partnerships with influencers and content creators. You will play a key part in promoting game launches, securing meaningful media coverage and increasing audience engagement. You will also establish and grow player communities across Discord and Steam, helping games build loyal audiences before and after release. Working closely with developers and cross-functional publishing and marketing teams, you will contribute directly to the commercial success of an exciting portfolio of indie games. This is an opportunity to take ownership, experiment with creative approaches and make a measurable impact in a fully remote, international environment. Accountabilities Develop and execute PR and communications strategies for the publishing label and individual game releases, collaborating closely with the Social Media Manager to maximise visibility and commercial impact. Build, maintain and leverage relationships with games journalists, media outlets, influencers and content creators to secure reviews, features, coverage and promotional opportunities. Create compelling narratives around games, developers and upcoming releases, translating their unique selling points into engaging press releases, announcements and media pitches. Plan and coordinate PR initiatives and creator campaigns around key milestones, including game reveals, demos, Early Access launches and full releases. Establish, develop and actively manage player communities on Discord and Steam Community, driving engagement and fostering long-term relationships with players. Plan, host and deliver Steam livestreams to showcase games, engage audiences and support key promotional activities. Collaborate with developers and internal publishing, production and marketing teams to ensure consistent messaging, maximise exposure and address player feedback. Track media coverage, creator activity, community sentiment and campaign performance, using insights and data to continuously improve communication strategies and engagement. Requirements Demonstrable experience in PR, influencer marketing, media relations or marketing communications, preferably within the PC and console gaming industry. An active and established network of games media contacts, journalists, influencers and content creators, with recent examples of successfully leveraging these relationships to secure coverage and promotional exposure. Hands-on experience planning, hosting and delivering Steam livestreams. Proven experience building, growing and actively managing gaming communities, particularly on Discord and Steam Community. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce engaging press releases, media pitches and promotional content. Strong understanding of the PC and console games market, independent game developers and gaming audiences. A proactive, commercially minded and hands-on approach, with the ability to manage multiple games and release campaigns in a growing publishing environment. Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, combined with the ability to give and receive constructive feedback. A performance-driven mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes, continuous improvement and experimentation. A curious, adaptable and solution-oriented attitude, with the confidence to take ownership, learn from mistakes and turn ideas into actionable results. Benefits Competitive compensation: Salary based on qualifications, experience and suitability for the role. Equipment allowance: Financial support to purchase your own device or work equipment. Annual bonus: Opportunity to receive variable compensation through an annual bonus programme. Work from anywhere: Fully remote working, with the freedom to work from anywhere in the world. Flexible schedule: No fixed working hours, allowing you to organise your schedule around your responsibilities. Unlimited paid time off: Flexibility to take the time you need to recharge. International environment: Collaborate with a diverse, supportive and energetic team spread across six continents and more than 30 countries. Professional growth: An environment that encourages experimentation, continuous learning, ownership and career development. Direct impact: Freedom to contribute ideas, take initiative and present proposals directly to management. Global flexibility: Travel freely and receive compensation in your preferred currency. review_candidates.title: Head of European Partner Engagement and Research
review_candidates.description: Who We Are The Partnership on AI (PAI) is the leading forum addressing the most important and difficult decisions on the future of AI. We are a nonprofit that invites diverse voices into the process of technical governance, design, and deployment of AI technologies. Our diverse Partners work together across industry, academia, and civil society to form responsible AI solutions so that AI empowers humanity -- contributing to a more just, equitable, and prosperous world. WHY EUROPE, WHY NOW Europe is an essential contributor to PAI's mission, home to a number of critical organisations and institutions leading the way on safe and responsible AI. PAI already counts more than 20 partner organisations across the UK and Europe — spanning private sector partners in and outside the tech industry, civil society, media, and academic institutions, alongside close collaboration with policy bodies. Joining our team here means working at the centre of that network. Candidates should expect to travel to the selected city for monthly in-person meetups. Role Summary The Head of Europe will join PAI's international department to lead the organization's engagement and research within the European AI ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, International this role will set and lead PAI's engagement and research strategy in Europe by deepening relationships with existing partners and stakeholders, identifying and cultivating new partnerships, and leading convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key stakeholders across industry, civil society, and academia. The role will lead the development of guidance and research outputs that align PAI's global programmatic priorities with issues of direct relevance and resonance in the region. Beyond its European focus, the role also carries a broader international component. The Head of Europe will partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new PAI hubs in new regions and engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South. What You’ll Do Stakeholder Engagement & Partnership Development (Est. time: 30%) Serve as PAI’s primary point of contact and relationship-builder in Europe, reinforcing the organization’s role as a bridge between sectors and geographies. Deepen and sustain relationships with PAI’s existing partners and stakeholders across Europe, including industry, civil society, academia, and government, in collaboration with the Programs & Research and Policy teams. Identify new strategic and meaningful partners in Europe, that expands PAI reach and multistakeholder community. In cooperation with the Partnership Development team, identify, cultivate, and engage new strategic partners in Europe who expand PAI’s reach and multistakeholder community and advance its mission in the region. Working with the Director of Development, identify and pursue European funding opportunities (including foundations, philanthropic organizations, corporate partners), and contribute to proposals and strategic fundraising tied to PAI’s European events and initiatives. Convenings & Coordination (Est. time: 20%) Drive activities to convene and support PAI’s European Steering Committee (including preparation of position papers and agendas). Contribute to other relevant related committees in Europe, such as the Policy Steering Committee, by participating in their convenings and virtual events, and by providing feedback and suggestions on their composition and outputs, ensuring complementarity and cross-pollination. Design, organize, and host convenings, meetings, and brainstorms with key partners and stakeholders. Oversee logistics and substantive content for European events, ensuring they reflect PAI's multi-stakeholder approach and mission. Represent PAI at relevant European conferences, working groups, and policy forums. Research & Guidance Development (Est. time: 30%) Identify and scope emerging, high-impact, and time-sensitive topics for PAI’s research in Europe. Lead the development of guidance and research outputs aligned with PAI's global programmatic priorities, with direct relevance and resonance for the European region. Work closely with members of the Programs & Research as well as Policy teams to deliver this goal. Working with the Communications team, author and co-author research papers, blogs, and op-eds in collaboration with PAI staff and Partners that build visibility around PAI research and engagement in Europe. Contribute European perspectives and expertise to PAI's global research agenda. Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Broader International Strategy (Est. time: 20%) Work closely with internal PAI departments to ensure European insights inform global programmatic and research priorities. Partner with the Managing Director, International in implementing PAI's international strategy, including the potential launch of new regional hubs. Support engagement with non-Western stakeholders, including in the Global South, and represent PAI at international convenings. Other This role requires flexibility to work extended or later hours one to two days per week to accommodate meetings with colleagues in U.S. time zones, ensuring overlap with Eastern and Pacific working hours. The position also involves travel of approximately 20% of the time, both within Europe and internationally, including to North America and Africa. The list of responsibilities set out are not exhaustive It may be necessary to adapt tasks within the scope of the role as needed. Who You Are / What We’re Looking For Masters degree or higher in related discipline or equivalent (7-10 years) work experience required. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across a distributed, international team. A strong team player, who is able to work across the organization, and coordinate between teams when designing/delivering work. Significant professional experience in AI policy, governance, technology partnerships, or a related field, with a demonstrated understanding of the European AI ecosystem. Proven track record of building and managing relationships with senior stakeholders across industry, civil society, academia, and/or government. Experience designing and leading convenings, working groups, or multi-stakeholder initiatives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex, multi-stakeholder input into clear guidance and research outputs. Fluency in English required; additional European languages a plus. Willingness to travel across Europe as needed for convenings and stakeholder meetings Preferred Qualifications Ability to navigate a small yet complex institution Willingness to participate constructively on organizational priorities beyond the immediate focus of their work Existing network of relationships with European AI policymakers, civil society organizations, and industry leaders. Familiarity with PAI's mission, programmatic work, and multi-stakeholder model. Experience contributing to or authoring research or guidance documents on AI governance topics. Comfort with institutional change and periods of ambiguity Qualities That Are Important To Us Justice: Notices and addresses inequities, includes diverse perspectives, and acts fairly in decisions and collaboration. Trust: Communicates openly, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates reliability and integrity. Respect: Listens fully, values others’ time and contributions, and collaborates thoughtfully. Compassion: Shows empathy, patience, and care, especially when supporting colleagues or navigating challenges. Additional Information We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. What matters most is your commitment to PAI’s mission and the potential you bring. We are actively interested in building a diverse pool of candidates and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Compensation PAI’s compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to fairness and equity across our distributed team. Compensation is based on role level, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity. The compensation range for this role depends on where you are based: London, UK: £88,166 – £96,985 GBP Brussels, Belgium: €109,574 – €120,534 EUR Amsterdam, Netherlands: €103,764 – €120,333 EUR In Belgium, the required 13th-month pay and double holiday pay are paid on top of this base salary range. In the Netherlands, the statutory 8% holiday allowance is paid on top of this base salary range. Benefits PAI offers a generous paid leave and benefits package. Time off, health, and retirement benefits are tailored to each country, with the aim of being comparable to our US package. Our benefits currently include: Generous paid vacation, local public holidays, three personal reflection days, and sick and family leave in line with or above local requirements Health and retirement benefits tailored to each country Monthly cell phone reimbursement Annual funds to support professional development Monthly allowance for co-working space access Regular team lunches and focused work days Opportunities to attend AI-related conferences and collaborate with our partners across industry, academia, and civil society Please refer to our careers page for an updated list of benefits. Location and Work Authorization PAI is a remote-first organization with a global membership base and scope. This role is eligible for remote work in London (UK), Brussels (Belgium), or Amsterdam (Netherlands). Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they will be based. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time. Partnership on AI (PAI) is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and supported. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions based on qualifications, skills, experience, and organizational needs, without discrimination. Our commitment to equal opportunity extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, professional development, advancement, compensation, and benefits. We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Candidates who require reasonable adjustments or accommodations during the hiring process are encouraged to let us know. How To Apply Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. To apply, please submit a cover letter and resume. Our hiring process typically includes an initial HR screen, one or more interviews with the hiring team, and a final conversation with senior leadership. We aim to keep candidates informed at each stage and will communicate expected timelines at the outset. The Pay Range For This Role Is 88,166 - 96,985 GBP per year(London, United Kingdom) 109,574 - 120,534 EUR per year(Brussels, Belgium) 103,764 - 120,333 EUR per year(Amsterdam, Netherlands)

By combining creativity, strategic thinking, data, and technology, we deliver experiences that inspire customers and help our partners grow. Based in our Amsterdam office and part of a close-knit Group Finance team spanning Amsterdam, Hong Kong and London, you'll take the lead on tax compliance and reporting across our key markets - the Netherlands, UK, US, Canada and South Africa - while helping shape a consistent, high-quality approach for subsidiaries worldwide. You'll be the go-to person who keeps us accurate, on time and in control, and you'll have the scope to modernise how we work by bringing in smart tax technology and AI. Run the Group's tax compliance calendar, staying ahead of deadlines and flagging risks early. Manage our transfer pricing model and documentation (Masterfile and Local Files) alongside external advisors. Keep us current on changing tax law, transfer pricing, FX, withholding tax and loss relief - and act on what it means for us. Prepare tax budgets, forecasts and cash tax estimates. Support our subsidiaries worldwide (Europe, Asia and Pacific) Give tax compliance and reporting oversight to our other Group subsidiaries, helping local teams get it right. Champion one consistent, high-quality approach across every territory, spotting and escalating risks as they arise. Handle VAT and employment taxes Manage the Group's European VAT compliance and advise operations on VAT in their day-to-day contracts. Support international payroll, employment tax and global mobility questions as they come up. Modernise How We Work Put tax technology and AI to work to automate and sharpen our compliance and reporting processes. Strip out manual steps, strengthen controls and build the case for smarter tools. Help embed tax into the roll-out of our new group-wide finance system. review_candidates.title: Group Director, Control Tower
review_candidates.description: Are you ready to build the function that brings the full strength of NTG together? At NTG, our entrepreneurial companies have always been our greatest strength. Today, more and more customers are looking for logistics partners who can do more than move goods from A to B. They want one point of contact, full visibility across their supply chain, and a partner who can orchestrate solutions across countries, transport modes, and business units. That's why we're establishing NTG Control Tower. We're looking for a commercially driven and operationally strong Group Director, Control Tower, to build and lead this new Group capability from the ground up. Welcome to NTG – Nordic Transport Group NTG (Nordic Transport Group) is one of Europe's fastest-growing freight forwarding and logistics groups. Founded in 2011, NTG has grown through partnerships with strong local specialists and today consists of more than 80 companies with activities in more than 26 countries. While our businesses maintain their entrepreneurial spirit and local market expertise, together they form a powerful international logistics network spanning road, air, ocean, warehousing and value-added logistics services. Our everyday reality is fast-moving - and that’s exactly how we like it. About the role As Group Director, Control Tower , you will be responsible for establishing NTG Control Tower as a new Group function designed to strengthen existing customer relationships and attract new strategic business opportunities. The purpose of the Control Tower is simple: To give customers access to the full capabilities of NTG through one coordinated setup, while designing the solution that best fits their needs. Where customer needs extend beyond NTG's own capabilities, the Control Tower will identify and integrate complementary external solutions to create the best overall outcome. Working across the NTG network, you will act as the link between customers, our companies and external partners, ensuring that customers experience NTG as one integrated logistics partner. Reporting to the Group CCO Road & Logistics, you will work closely with management teams across Europe. Your mission Design and build the Control Tower: operating model, processes, systems, KPIs and, over time, the team Be the single point of contact for our strategic multi-country and multimodal customers Give customers full visibility, proactive exception management and data-driven performance reporting Act as solution architect for complex customer opportunities, designing end-to-end setups that combine NTG capabilities with externally sourced logistics services and partners whenever required. Develop existing customer relationships and help win new customers with a true one-stop-shop offering The profile that can make it happen You bring experience from logistics, supply chain management or integrated customer solutions, and you understand what it takes to manage complex transport flows across organisations, countries and stakeholders. Combined with a solid understanding of transport management systems, visibility platforms and data-driven performance reporting, you're able to create transparency, drive performance and connect customer needs with operational execution. You have a track record of creating something where little or nothing existed before. Perhaps you've built a Control Tower function, launched a 4PL setup, developed a strategic customer programme or led the creation of a new logistics capability. In any case, you're used to operating without a blueprint. Above all, you're motivated by ownership. By the opportunity to build a strategic capability from the ground up and you know how to connect customer needs with operational execution and how to create value across countries, business units and transport modes. Fluent English is required, while Scandinavian language skills are considered an advantage. Ready to build NTG's next strategic capability? If you’re currently in a senior operational or commercial role within logistics, supply chain management or integrated customer solutions and want to step into a position with full ownership - this is your opportunity. Apply with your CV and tell us why you're the right person to build and lead the NTG Control Tower. Questions? We'd be happy to tell you more about the role. Contact Jesper Kroggaard, Group CCO Road & Logistics.
